stream.text: [STATIC]...This is triage center 4. We are out of morphine and clean bandages...[STATIC]
[STATIC]...Patient zero is still unstable. Please, we need a containment team immediately! [COF][COF]...[STATIC]
[STATIC]...To any surviving medical staff: report to the East Wing for reorganization...[STATIC]
[STATIC]...The infection rate is climbing. We can't keep them out of the ward much longer... [NOISE][SCREAMING]...[STATIC]
[STATIC]...Is anyone receiving this? We have three wounded civilians. Please respond...[STATIC]
